name: Thrain Copperkettle
source_profile: ● Thrain Copperkettle (LN) is a wealthy foundry owner and influential member of the Emberhearth council. He maintains extensive commercial relationships with Westbridge merchants and advocates closer cooperation with Marquis Bellamy, even if doing so requires accepting greater Cadorian oversight of the district's workshops.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 77 (source excerpt; may be partial)
